name: manifest-write-20261107-m
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,base64,datetime
p=Path.cwd();expected='755f13daeedabfd4cb1e66d6b85956013e6727e2de8adfe7de351fdf73c3dfad'
assert hashlib.sha256((p/'reservation.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected
assert (p/'reservation.sha256').read_text().strip()==expected
records=json.loads((p/'raw-provenance.json').read_text())['records'];ids={str(i) for i in json.loads((p/'reservation.json').read_text())['ids']};results=json.loads((p/'results.json').read_text());assert set(results)==set(records)==ids and len(ids)==20
for k,v in records.items():
 b=(p/'raw'/f'{k}.jsonl').read_bytes();assert b==base64.b64decode(v['raw_base64']);assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==v['raw_sha256'];assert json.loads(b)==v['object'];assert hashlib.sha256(v['object']['statement'].encode()).hexdigest()==v['statement_sha256'];assert hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(v['object'],sort_keys=True,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest()==v['object_canonical_sha256'];assert b.endswith(b'\n')
print('Bootstrap named files', [f.name for f in p.iterdir() if 'bootstrap' in f.name])
(p/'reservation-checks.json').write_text(json.dumps({'expected_sha256':expected,'before_extraction':'first-source-20261107-a.receipt.json/output.txt','after_actual_handback_writes_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'reservation_sha256':hashlib.sha256((p/'reservation.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'sha_file_matches':True,'exact20keys':True,'raw_record_object_statement_hashes_all_verified':True,'final_reread':'final-disk-check-20261107-n.output.txt'},indent=2)+'\n')
print('Prepared manifest payload; completed writer receipt will be included by final verifier construction step.')
